content.rendered:
Laurel Ridge Middle School will be hosting two Registration Open-house sessions this year. All families and grade levels are welcome to attend either session. Registration sessions will be held at LRMS in the commons. 


 * Wednesday, August 21st: 4:30 – 7:30 pm
 * Thursday, August 22nd: 9:00 am – 2:00 pm

Registration packets have been mailed home. Please review the Welcome Letter in the packets for additional information.    


School Supply lists for 2019-20: English  Spanish
